name: Ramaco Resources
outlook:
What Ramaco Resources says to expect

  • Full year 2026: production and sales volumesOn the back of continued production discipline in the high-vol market, full-year 2026 production guidance is now 3.5 – 3.6 million tons, down from 3.6 – 3.9 million tons. Full-year 2026 sales guidance is changed to 4.0 – 4.1 million tons versus 4.0 – 4.3 million tons.
  • Full year 2026: cash cost per tonThe Company is increasing 2026 cash cost guidance from $96 - $99 per ton to $101 - $103 per ton.
  • Full year 2026: capital expendituresThe Company is increasing 2026 capital expenditure guidance to $97 – $102 million from $92 - $97 million.
The company's own words, from its earnings release (Form 8-K, Exhibit 99), filed November 3, 2026. They are its expectations, not ours, and not a forecast or price target from The Filing Desk. Replaced when the next release is out.
